model.name: Goals model
model.how: Each team's attack and defence strength from this season and last, newer matches weighing more, plus the home edge. That gives a projected score and the chance of every result.
model.test: Scored on 449 matches this season (five big European leagues and internationals), each predicted only from earlier matches: the model's favourite won 54% (it expected 54%); favourites it rated 60% or better won 77% of 129 (expected 72%); it called over or under 2.5 goals right 58% of the time.
